global _start
section .text
_start:
    ; read one digit + newline from stdin
    mov rax, 0
    mov rdi, 0
    mov rsi, buf
    mov rdx, 2
    syscall
    ; n = digit - '0'; v = n * 2 (two-digit safe: input 0-9)
    movzx rax, byte [buf]
    sub rax, '0'
    add rax, rax
    ; tens = v / 10, ones = v % 10
    xor rdx, rdx
    mov rbx, 10
    div rbx
    add rax, '0'
    add rdx, '0'
    mov [outbuf+0], al
    mov [outbuf+1], dl
    mov [outbuf+2], byte 10
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, outbuf
    mov rdx, 3
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
section .data
outbuf db 0, 0, 10
section .bss
buf resb 2
